findings.summary: Removed the false claim that pathogenic_classifiers.py L405-433 is a get_pp3/phyloP-window helper or a direct correct-idiom proof. L405-433 is get_pm1 — a DIFFERENT criterion's generic domain max-aggregation — cited ONLY as corroboration, never proof by itself. Defecthood is now grounded PRIMARILY in get_pp3 L944-954 / get_bp4 L491-503 own code+comments (dead best_score sentinel intended-but-never-reassigned, permanently-false BP4 `best_score>1` consensus guard, `>=`-loop last-tool resolution vs the blocks' own 'best score'/'same max score' comments and downstream strength/tie logic).

Restated the transcript/NTHL1 issue as a CURRENTLY ACTIVE committed production-path defect (not hypothetical): configs/acmg/tsc.yaml enables edge_cases.non_mane_transcript=true (L95) with a TSC2-only genes map pinned .5; BiasTsvSource yields raw .4; pipeline check_out_of_scope_gene + check_edge_cases misroute the full TSC2 corpus (EDGE_CASE_ROUTED) and every TSC1 row (OUT_OF_SCOPE_GENE) if the current production pipeline is run on real .4 rows. Census 30 NTHL1 manual is a separate analysis, not proof the pipeline works. Added AC-C7: a mandatory regression loading the real committed config + representative real .4 BIAS rows through the actual bias_source/policy/pipeline path, demonstrating baseline misroute then corrected behavior while the 30 NTHL1 manual rows are preserved.
